chapter_title_en: Stirs Beyond the Seas — The Void Heaven Palace
chapter_seo_title: Void Heaven Palace Entry: Han Li’s Perilous Treasure Hunt Begins
chapter_meta_description: Han Li arrives at the legendary Void Heaven Palace, a floating jade fortress in the sky. But the palace itself may be the greatest threat—its name makes his eyes bleed, and old acquaintances await inside.
og_title: 🏯 Han Li Enters the Void Heaven Palace
og_description: The palace is beautiful. The architecture is lethal. The old friends are definitely going to cause trouble.
twitter_title: Han Li just walked into a palace that hurts to look at.
twitter_description: Void Heaven Palace revealed—jade pillars, ancient beasts, and a long corridor designed to crush your soul before you even reach the main hall.

lore_anchors.definition: A traditional Chinese unit of length, approximately 3.33 meters.
A legendary floating palace of white jade, said to house primordial treasures and ancient tests.
The third major cultivation realm, where a cultivator condenses their qi into a solid core.
A cultivator's non-physical perception, often blocked by powerful ancient formations.
Prehistoric written characters that often carry residual Dao power; can harm cultivators who stare too long.
A protective light shield that only admits cultivators carrying a specific map-token.
A cloth map that functions as both navigational tool and access token for the Void Heaven Palace.
Carved stone pillars in the main hall, each engraved with unique mythical beasts; likely part of a larger formation.
